prompt: During a rolling update, what does `maxSurge` limit?

choices.text: How many pods may be not ready
choices.why: That is `maxUnavailable`.

choices.text: How many rollouts may run at once
choices.why: A Deployment runs one rollout.

choices.text: How fast the image is pulled
choices.why: Pulling is the kubelet's business.
Right.

prompt: A Deployment has 8 replicas, `maxSurge: 2` and `maxUnavailable: 0`. What is the most pods it can have during a rollout?

hint: What could the controller do first?

choices.text: No pod could be added or removed
choices.why: Right, so the rollout could never move.

choices.text: Zero is not a valid percentage
choices.why: `0` is accepted for either field on its own.

choices.text: It would need twice the nodes
choices.why: It would need no extra room at all.
`Recreate` has no such fields.

prompt: The nodes are full. Which setting still lets a rollout proceed?
hint: Which one needs no extra pods?

choices.why: The extra pod has nowhere to go.
Two extra pods with no room is worse.
Right, it frees a slot before it fills one.
Still extra pods first.

prompt: During an update, a client gets `Connection refused` from the shop. What is the likeliest cause?
hint: Two things start at the same moment.

choices.why: A broken pod never gets ready, so it gets no traffic.

choices.text: A stopping pod was still in the rules
choices.why: Right, the gap a `preStop` sleep covers.
That sets the pace, not the gap.

choices.text: The Service lost its selector halfway through
choices.why: Every request would fail then.

prompt: A pod has `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30` and a `preStop` sleep of 25 seconds. How long does the process get after `SIGTERM`?
hint: The grace period includes the hook.

choices.why: The hook used 25 of them.
They are not added.
Right.

choices.text: None, it is killed at once
choices.why: There are seconds left.

prompt: A new version crashes at start, with `maxSurge: 1` and `maxUnavailable: 0`. How many old pods are lost?
hint: An old pod leaves only after a new one is ready.

choices.why: Right, the rollout stops at one new pod.
That would need `maxUnavailable: 1`.
Only `Recreate` removes them all first.
That is the default, not this setting.

prompt: After `kubectl rollout undo`, what is left that will undo the fix?

choices.why: It is what undo went back to.
History does not apply anything.
Right, the next apply ships it.
It is a label, not a template.

prompt: Put in order what happens when a Deployment replaces one old pod under `maxSurge: 1` and `maxUnavailable: 0`.
items: The new pod passes its readiness probe
An old pod is told to stop
trap: The hook comes before the signal, not after.

prompt: To go back to one specific revision: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/shop --___=2`.
